# Twinkle Locs

> Handcrafted loc bead accessories made in Nigeria for loc wearers
> in Nigeria and worldwide. Founded by Unoma.

## What we sell
- Gold loc beads (packs of 50-200, sizes 2mm, 4mm, 6mm)
- Silver loc beads (packs of 50-200, sizes 2mm, 4mm, 6mm)
- Onyx loc beads (packs of 50-200, sizes 2mm, 4mm, 6mm)
- Crystal loc beads (packs of 50-200, sizes 2mm, 4mm, 6mm)
- 24k Gold loc beads (premium range)
- Loc bead application shears
- Bead threading kits

## Prices
Beads start at NGN 15,000 per pack of 50.
Premium 24k Gold range starts at NGN 19,500.
Shears from NGN 3,500.

## Shipping
Lagos: NGN 6,000, 1-2 business days.
Other Nigerian states: NGN 9,500, 3-5 business days.
International: available on request via WhatsApp.
